summary: This directory provides internal logic and utilities for locating, resolving, and loading static JSON configuration files used by the application during initialization or build processes.
responsibilities: Identify root directories for configuration files
Resolve file paths for static JSON configurations
Load and parse JSON configuration data
relationships: Configuration loading relies on path resolution to locate the correct JSON files.
Root directory identification provides the base path necessary for resolving specific configuration files.
designDecisions: Internal visibility to encapsulate configuration loading logic from public APIs
Comprehensive testing of file path resolution and JSON loading routines
